title: Poem: “Eve's Genesis Nemesis”
summary: A short rhyming poem in which Satan, the Evil one, slithers up to Eve, asks “Want to see light?” and coaxes her to wander over to the tree's bough and take a bite.

text.text: Vilefully, Wilefully, Satan, the Evil one, slithers to Eve and says, “Want to see light?”
No need to ponder how, why don’t you wander now, over to yonder bough, and take a bite.

things: tree of the knowledge of good and evil
